title: Pétrin Doré on Fairmount closing?? sign in the window
where: Mile End Neighbours board > Local businesses

messages.author: jules_on_waverly
messages.body: Walked by Pétrin Doré this morning and there's a sign taped on the door: "Fermé du 4 au 18 janvier. Grande nouvelle bientôt!" plus the shelves looked half empty. Anyone know what's going on? Please don't tell me we're losing the only place that still does a proper pain de campagne around here.

messages.author: Marc-Antoine L.
messages.body: My cousin works in real estate, he says the whole building at that corner was sold in the fall. Ground floor commercial + 3 apartments. You know what that usually means... condos and a bank or a vape shop downstairs. "Grande nouvelle" lol. Sad if true.

messages.author: noodle_and_crumb
messages.body: Not to be that person but didn't they sell those prepaid bread books in October? Like 12 loaves up front? Collect a bunch of cash right before the holidays then put up a "closed" sign. I'm not saying it's on purpose but the timing is not great. I bought one and I have 7 loaves left on it.

messages.author: Priya S.
messages.body: Come on, the woman has been there since like 2009, she knows half the street by name. She gave my kid a free chocolatine every Saturday for a year. I really doubt it's a scam. Could just be vacation? Bakers work 6 days a week, they're allowed two weeks off.

messages.author: D. Bergeron
messages.body: I'm a regular too and I like her, but honestly people paid $60 for those carnets and now there's a vague sign and rumours about the building. A two-week vacation doesn't need a "big news soon". Mme Gagnon, I know you read this board sometimes. If you're closing or moving, people deserve a straight answer before the 4th, not a surprise. What happens to the carnets?
